div.div: Nothing half-finished is ever shown. React keeps the last committed list on screen while the new one is built off-screen — which is why isPending exists, and why the old results stay visible instead of flashing to a spinner.

div.div: A transition does not make the work faster. It makes it interruptible, so the urgent update never has to wait behind it.
